The PEACOCK project

A language for AI-native software.

An independent programming language and development ecosystem in active, early-stage construction.

Experimental · not self-hosting

A programming language for AI-native work

PEACOCK brings a real .pac language, a bootstrap compiler and VM, CPU tensor/autodiff tools, and an original software graphics stack into one carefully scoped project.

Explore the languageRun your first program

Python remains the bootstrap. The compiler is not yet self-hosting; mobile, GPU and 3D backends are not implemented.

What works today

These are executable, tested subsystems—not implied platform promises.

Implemented

The language and VM

A typed .pac subset compiles through verified IR and bytecode into the Python-hosted PEACOCK VM.

CPU · small models

Small-scale AI

Tensor operations, reverse-mode autodiff, dense layers, SGD/Adam, training and evaluation run on CPU.

Software reference

Colour and 2D graphics

Perceptual colour utilities, a deterministic 2D software rasteriser and PNG output are available.

Shadow · experimental

Self-hosting

PEACOCK lexer/parser parity and expanded semantic-kernel probes; the Python analyser remains authoritative.

A long horizon, with explicit boundaries

PEACOCK is an independent language project—not a wrapper around a third-party ML or UI framework.

Working subset

Language first

A hand-written lexer, parser, static checker, IR verifier, optimiser, bytecode compiler and VM.

CPU verified

AI in the type model

Tensor shapes and dtypes inform checks; tested gradients and tiny neural-network workloads are present.

2D today

Original visual stack

Colour, rasterisation, motion and layout foundations exist; a general interactive UI toolkit and 3D renderer do not.

Open status

Evidence over slogans

Tests, limitations, bootstrap boundaries and missing targets are documented in the repository.

Experimental language and ecosystem. Status is evidence-led, not a release claim.
